start.text: You look new here. Need help finding your way? The chai stall has the best cutting chai in the airport.

choices.text: Where do I catch a bus to the city?
Which area should I look for a PG in?

bus.text: Vayu Vajra, right outside gate 4. Goes to most of the city. Cash or card, both work.

insider.text: Depends on where you'll work. Whitefield if it's tech, Koramangala if it's startups. Don't sign anything before you see the water supply.

farewell.text: Take care. It's a good city, once it stops being loud.
